subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should the shared self-heal be the canonical recovery, with Discord using its existing dedupe-aware retryable boundary only as a fallback?
rationale: The current inner loop cannot heal persistent wedges and bypasses Discord's explicit replay-release contract when exhausted; maintainer intent is needed to define whether layered channel recovery remains desirable after the shared fix.

options.title: Shared heal plus dedupe-aware fallback
options.body: Land shared persistent recovery, then retain only a Discord fallback that releases replay state or visibly reports exhaustion.

options.title: Shared heal only
options.body: Use the common-owner recovery alone if Discord proof demonstrates that no separate transport fallback is needed.

options.title: Accept the partial mitigation
options.body: Land the short inner retry despite persistent same-key conflicts still becoming silent losses after exhaustion.

recommendation.title: Shared heal plus dedupe-aware fallback
recommendation.body: Land shared persistent recovery, then retain only a Discord fallback that releases replay state or visibly reports exhaustion.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal spans Discord processing ownership, adjacent merge decisions, and cross-layer product judgment.
